sql: select date_trunc('day', started_at) day, count(*) passes, round(avg(programs_listed)) avg_listed, max(programs_listed) max_listed, round(avg(extract(epoch from finished_at-started_at))::numeric,1) avg_secs from incentive_discovery_cycles where started_at > now() - interval '6 days' group by 1 order by 1
